newsitem.title: USA: El Paso says N.M. natgas pipeline repaired.
newsitem.headline: El Paso says N.M. natgas pipeline repaired.

text.p: El Paso Natural Gas Co said it has repaired one of two New Mexico natural gas pipelines damaged Tuesday, restoring about 480 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of transmission service of the 550 mmcfd taken out in the incident.
Repair of one of the damaged pipelines returned the Permian-San Juan Crossover system to service on Thursday, El Paso said in a statement.
El Paso said a 30-inch pipeline failed about 30 miles north of Roswell, N.M., on Tuesday which contained two parallel pipelines.
Testing of the second line was continuing, and no firm date had been set for a return to service, El Paso said.
El Paso Natural Gas is the transmission subsidiary of El Paso Energy Corp.
